_meta.name: DozeForge bloatware seed
_meta.author: DozeForge project (original data)
_meta.schema: package -> { list, removal, description }. removal ∈ {Recommended, Advanced, Expert, Unsafe}. list ∈ {Aosp, Carrier, Google, Misc, Oem}.
_meta.note: This is DozeForge's OWN curated seed of well-known preinstalled packages, with original descriptions and risk ratings. It is NOT the UAD-NG database and contains no GPL data. Users can optionally download the full community UAD-NG list at runtime (scripts/sync-uad-list.mjs writes it to the app data dir); when present it is overlaid on top of this seed. The GPL-licensed community list is never bundled in the binary.

com.google.android.apps.photos.description: Google Photos. Cloud photo backup/gallery. Safe to disable; reinstall from Play Store.

com.google.android.videos.description: Google TV / Play Movies. Streaming storefront.

com.google.android.youtube.description: YouTube. Disabling stops background playback service.

com.google.android.apps.maps.description: Google Maps. Other apps may depend on it for navigation intents.

com.google.android.apps.wellbeing.description: Digital Wellbeing. Screen-time controls; parental controls may depend on it.

com.google.android.apps.turbo.description: Device Health Services. Adaptive Battery model provider; disabling degrades battery predictions.

com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox.description: Google App / Assistant / 'Hey Google'. Disabling removes voice search and the search widget.

com.google.android.gms.description: Google Play Services. Core dependency for push, location, login. Do NOT disable.

com.google.android.gsf.description: Google Services Framework. Required for GCM/FCM push. Do NOT disable.

com.android.vending.description: Google Play Store. Do NOT disable unless you know what you're doing.

com.google.android.partnersetup.description: Partner/RLZ referral tracking. Safe to disable.

com.google.ar.core.description: ARCore. Only needed for AR apps.

com.sec.android.app.samsungapps.description: Galaxy Store. Disabling stops Samsung app updates.

com.samsung.android.app.aodservice.description: Always On Display. Disable if you don't use AOD.

com.samsung.android.spay.description: Samsung Wallet/Pay. Disabling removes NFC payments.

com.samsung.android.messaging.description: Samsung Messages. Disabling breaks SMS unless another SMS app is set.

com.miui.msa.global.description: Xiaomi MSA — the ad framework behind MIUI system ads. Highly recommended to disable.

com.motorola.ccc.ota.description: Motorola OTA updater. Disabling blocks system updates.

com.facebook.system.description: Facebook App Manager (installs/updates FB apps silently).

com.android.chrome.description: Chrome. Often the default browser; other apps may open links through it.

com.google.android.webview.description: Android System WebView. Renders web content inside apps. Do NOT disable — many apps will crash.

com.android.systemui.description: System UI (status bar, navigation, notifications). Disabling bootloops the device.

com.android.providers.media.description: Media storage provider. Do NOT disable.

com.dti.att.description: AT&T DeviceHelp. Carrier app; may affect support flows.
